attributes.description: Jyoti Resins And Adhesives Ltd. is a manufacturer of synthetic resin adhesives. The company manufactures various types of wood adhesives (white glue), under the brand name of EURO 7000 , which was launched in 2006, and is now the second largest selling wood adhesive brand in India in the retail segment.
